articles.summary: U.S. Bank appointed Lauren Massuci as head of Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Sales and Jose Quevedo as head of Diversified Industries Sales within its Payments: Merchant and Institutional (PMI) Sales Distribution team. Both report to Peter Geronimo, executive vice president and head of PMI Sales Distribution, Institutional Client Group (ICG). Lauren Massuci has more than 18 years of experience in treasury management sales, payments, and business development. She previously served as senior vice president and Treasury Management Sales leader at PNC's Financial Institutions Group and held sales and leadership roles at Citi's Treasury and Trade Solutions organization. Jose Quevedo leads payment sales for Diversified Industries at U.S. Bank, covering global industrials and services, commercial real estate, aerospace and defense, energy, and utilities. The role was created to align PMI Sales Distribution more closely with the bank's industry-focused approach within the Institutional
articles.title: U.S. Bank names Massuci and Quevedo to Payments sales leadership team
